title: Why Europe's youth are on the streets
ticker: France calls nationwide strike as protests over housing and living costs spread across Europe

scenes.title: Why Europe's youth are on the streets
scenes.say: From Paris to Milan to Lisbon, young Europeans are on the streets. Here's why.

scenes.title: Marches, clashes and cleared camps
scenes.say: France, Italy, Portugal and Belgium have all seen protests. The common thread is rent, wages and the rising cost of living.

scenes.title: A huge march, a huge police operation
scenes.say: In France, 410,000 people marched on Saturday. 70,000 police kept a lid on the looting seen a week earlier, and 1,314 people were arrested.
scenes.speak: In France, four hundred and ten thousand people marched on Saturday. Seventy thousand police kept a lid on the looting seen a week earlier, and one thousand three hundred and fourteen people were arrested.

scenes.title: Paris and Lyon

photos.caption: A shop window smashed in Paris

scenes.say: There were still sporadic clashes, in Paris, Lyon and Marseille. And police unions say they can't keep up this level of deployment for long.

scenes.title: France braces for more
scenes.say: Unions have called fresh rallies for 31 October and a nationwide strike on 5 November. The Yellow Vests are joining in.
scenes.speak: Unions have called fresh rallies for the thirty-first of October and a nationwide strike on the fifth of November. The Yellow Vests are joining in.

scenes.text: We see an aggregation of anger.
scenes.say: We see an aggregation of anger, says union leader Murielle Guilbert. Students, workers and firefighters are converging. And Macron, with strained finances and no majority, has little to offer.

scenes.title: Italy sends soldiers to Milan
scenes.say: In Italy, thousands marched in Milan, Rome and Turin. Giorgia Meloni sent 500 more soldiers to Milan, and luxury stores boarded up their windows.
scenes.speak: In Italy, thousands marched in Milan, Rome and Turin. Giorgia Meloni sent five hundred more soldiers to Milan, and luxury stores boarded up their windows.

scenes.title: A housing emergency
scenes.say: In Lisbon, police cleared a camp of more than 100 tents after a housing march, making 25 arrests. Activists say 60 people were hurt.
scenes.speak: In Lisbon, police cleared a camp of more than a hundred tents after a housing march, making twenty-five arrests. Activists say sixty people were hurt.

scenes.say: Portugal is short of 300,000 homes, as many as all of Lisbon. House prices have more than doubled since 2017.
scenes.speak: Portugal is short of three hundred thousand homes, as many as all of Lisbon. House prices have more than doubled since twenty seventeen.

items: France faces a strike as Macron's term winds down
Italy is fortifying its commercial capital
scenes.say: For India, key European partners have less bandwidth for trade and strategy. And the lesson travels: when homes slip out of reach for the young, anger follows.
